```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Load libraries
library(here)
library(sf)          # vector handling
library(terra)       # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)        # map making
library(viridisLite)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r}
# Import EEZ data and depth.tif
eez <- st_read(here("data", "wc_regions_clean.shp"))

depth <- rast(here("data", "depth.tif"))
```

```{r}
# Import SST and create raster stack

# Set directory for folder
sst_dir <- here::here("data", "sst")

# Create a list of all images that have the extension .tif and contain the word band
sst_rasters <- list.files(sst_dir,
                             pattern = glob2rx("*sst*.tif$"),
                             full.names = TRUE)

# Create a raster stack
sst_stack <- rast(sst_rasters) |> 
    terra::project("EPSG:4326") # Fix each raster's CRS
    # This was giving me trouble when I tried to stack sst and depth, so fixed here

```

```{r}
# Check CRS's !
if((st_crs(crs(depth)) == st_crs(crs(sst_stack))) & (st_crs(crs(depth)) == st_crs(crs(eez))) & (st_crs(crs(eez)) == st_crs(crs(sst_stack)))){
    print("CRS's match!")
  }else{
    print("CRS's DO NOT match!")
    st_crs(crs(eez))$epsg
    st_crs(crs(depth))$epsg
    st_crs(crs(sst_stack))$epsg
}
```

```{r}
# Find average SST and convert from Kelvin to Celsius
avg_sst <- mean(sst_stack, na.rm = TRUE) - 273.15
```

```{r}
# Crop and resample depth raster to match SST raster
depth_crop_resamp <- depth |> 
    crop(avg_sst) |> 
    resample(avg_sst, method = "bilinear")
```

```{r}
# Check that the depth and SST match in resolution, extent, and CRS's by stacking!
print(paste("Do CRS's match?", crs(depth_crop_resamp) == crs(avg_sst)))
# avg_sst_depth <- rast(c(avg_sst, depth_crop_resamp))
```

## Oyster Reclassification, Masking, and Mapping Function

```{r}
aq_opportunity_zones <- function(species, sst_min, sst_max, depth_min, depth_max){

    # SST Reclassification Matrix

    sst_rcl <- matrix(c(-Inf, sst_min, 0, # values -Inf to min = 0
                        sst_min, sst_max, 1,  # values min to max = 1
                        sst_max, Inf, 0), # values max to Inf = 0
                        ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

    # Depth Reclassification Matrix

    depth_rcl <- matrix(c(-Inf, depth_min, 0, # values -Inf to min = 0
                        depth_min, depth_max, 1,  # values min to max = 1
                        depth_max, Inf, 0), # values max to Inf = 0
                        ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

    # Apply reclasification matrices
    optimal_sst <- terra::classify(avg_sst, rcl = sst_rcl)
    optimal_depth <- terra::classify(depth_crop_resamp, rcl = depth_rcl)

    # Find locations where both SST AND depth AND EEZ = 1
    optimal_cond <- optimal_sst * optimal_depth

    # Rasterize EEZ
    eez_raster <- rasterize(eez, optimal_cond, field = 'rgn_key')

    # Mask optimal conditions by EEZ
    optimal_zones <- mask(optimal_cond, eez_raster)
                         
    area_by_eez <- (zonal(optimal_zones, eez_raster, fun = 'sum', na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
        as_tibble() |> 
        as.data.frame() |> 
        rename(sum = mean)

    # Join area dataset to eez dataset to use geometries, apply st_as_sf() to plot
    opportunity_zones <- inner_join(area_by_eez, eez, by = 'rgn_key') |> 
        st_as_sf() |> 
        select(rgn, area_km2)

    # Display oppotunity_zones in easy-to-read table
    kable_table <- kable(
        opportunity_zones, 
        format = 'simple', 
        col.names = c("Region", "Area (km^2)", "Geometry"),
        caption = paste("Oppotunity Area by Region for", species, "Aquaculture") 
        )

    ## Plot !
    opportunity_map <- tm_basemap("Esri.OceanBasemap") +
        tm_shape(opportunity_zones) +
        tm_options(component.autoscale = FALSE) +
        # Map exclusive economic zones by suitable area                     
        tm_polygons(fill = 'area_km2', lwd = 0.7, fill_alpha = 0.6,
                fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = 'brewer.yl_or_rd'),
                fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Optimal Area (km^2)",
                                        position = tm_pos_out('left'))) +
        tm_compass(position = c('left', 'bottom'), # Add compass
                    size = 2) +
        tm_scalebar(position = c('left', 'bottom')) + # Add scalebar
        tm_title(text = paste("Opportunity Zones for", species, "Aquaculture along the US West Coast"),
                size = 1,
                position = tm_pos_out('center', 'top')) +
        tm_labels(text = 'rgn', size = 0.5, fontface = 'bold', position = 'center')

    print(kable_table)
    opportunity_map
}
```

## Choosing Species!

**Generic Oyster Species** 
    - SST Range: 20-30 C 
    - Depth Range: 0-70 meters

**Species of Interest:** *Ostrea conchaphila,* aka the native Olympia oyster! 
    - SST Range: 6-20 C ([Source](https://www.interpretivecenter.org/news/the-olympia-oyster)) 
    - Depth Range: usually 0-50 meters ([SeaLifeBase](https://www.sealifebase.ca/summary/Ostrea-conchaphila.html))

### Generic Oyster Results

```{r}
aq_opportunity_zones(species = "Generic Oyster", sst_min = 20, sst_max = 30, depth_min = -70, depth_max = 0)
```

### Olympia Oyster Results

```{r}
aq_opportunity_zones(species = "Olympia Oyster", sst_min = 6, sst_max = 20, depth_min = -50, depth_max = 0)
```
